LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can you spell words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch an audio-visual clip on shops/stores (e.g. 书店、衣服店、食 品店、药店、鞋店、市场) then write down the mentioned names with the correct pinyin,

2. work with peers to match pictures of shops/stores to their appropriate names,

3. read a list of different currencies then rewrite them (e.g. 先令、元/块 ),

4. use the vocabulary on shops/stores to write simple sentences,

5. fill in the blanks with the appropriate words,

6. read the short dialogue related to a store visit then answer the questions ( e.g. 这个店卖什么? 男生想买什么? 书多少钱? 笔是多少先令? ),

7. role-play asking the price of different items in different shops/stores in turns then write the role-plays down,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch an audio-visual clip on shops/stores (e.g. 书店、衣服店、食 品店、药店、鞋店、市场) then write down the mentioned names with the correct pinyin,
2. work with peers to match pictures of shops/stores to their appropriate names,
3. read a list of different currencies then rewrite them (e.g. 先令、元/块 ),
4. use the vocabulary on shops/stores to write simple sentences,
5. fill in the blanks with the appropriate words,
6. read the short dialogue related to a store visit then answer the questions ( e.g. 这个店卖什么? 男生想买什么? 书多少钱? 笔是多少先令? ),
7. role-play asking the price of different items in different shops/stores in turns then write the role-plays down,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: the learner contributes to group decision-making by participating actively in completing the

sentences with the appropriate words.

Values:
Unity: the learner collaborates with others when they match pictures with their appropriate names.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Financial Literacy is nurtured as the learner becomes aware of how to make price inquiries in different shops/stores when

interacting with the texts on the theme.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their meaning to Pre-technical Studies on the concept of financial management and budgeting.
